rules.title: Clash rule editor
rules.help: One rule per line, matched from top to bottom. End with MATCH,target. Saved rules apply on the next Clash / Mihomo / Shadowrocket subscription download. Use the listed groups or built-in actions; nodes and groups remain template/plan managed.
rules.saved: Rules saved. Users receive them on subscription refresh.
commerce.privateExternalHelp: Mix private nodes into your own Clash / Mihomo / Shadowrocket subscription alongside your plan. Changes apply on the next client update.
commerce.privateExternalBoundary: Imports nodes only, without upstream rules, DNS or scripts. URLs are encrypted and never returned. Administrators can manage your private feeds. Limit: 10 feeds, 1000 nodes and 2 MiB of node data per account.
